verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own observability docs say Browserbase sessions get real-time screen recording and replay in the session dashboard. That replay is tied to the Browserbase backend rather than the Stagehand library itself, and nothing shows replay for local or CDP-attached runs. The run-time `screenshot` tool is an agent capability, not a debugging replay, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: step-by-step action timelines, screenshot capture tied to failed runs, replay support outside Browserbase, and independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging failed runs from replays.
